children: Microsoft (MSFT) fiscal Q1: revenue $90B (+18% YoY), annualized Azure >$100B, EPS $4.74 beat estimates. Shares jumped ~15% the day after release, largest single-day gain since 2008.
Microsoft (MSFT) says demand outpaces capacity; quarterly capex more than doubled year‑over‑year, free cash flow fell ~23% YoY, and capex is expected to rise in fiscal 2027.
Microsoft launched Execution Containers for MSFT: secure, restricted environments letting AI agents run on devices without accessing user data. Partners include Anthropic, OpenAI and Nvidia.
Microsoft (MSFT) was cited in U.S. officials' remarks alleging H-1B visa program fraud and claiming layoffs of U.S. workers while hiring thousands of H-1B holders and green card beneficiaries.
Microsoft says hybrid intelligence — pairing local computing with cloud — is its focus. CEO Satya Nadella highlights secure desktop execution for AI agents and on-device AI integrated with cloud.
MSFT traders: cloud growth, rising corporate AI spending and wider Copilot adoption boost investor optimism and support a renewed growth narrative for the company
Microsoft (MSFT) pushed its AI strategy into hardware at a Surface event, showcasing collaboration with Nvidia to ship AI-capable laptops and integrate AI across Microsoft products.
MSFT released Microsoft-Decision-1 to developers via Foundry, plans wider rollout on OpenRouter. Pricing: $0.042 per million input tokens; output tokens free. Future versions may use OpenAI tech.
Traders: Microsoft (MSFT) faces an immigration review after reports it cut about 6,000 U.S. jobs in 2025 while filing 6,000+ H-1B visas and 3,682 PERM applications.
Microsoft (MSFT) stock neared prior highs as focus shifted from capex fatigue to earnings. Traders noted breakeven sellers near $555 and that new earnings catalysts are needed for momentum.
